# Next Terminal Documentation

Official documentation for the self-hosted Next Terminal bastion host and secure remote access platform.

## Entry points
- Documentation home: https://docs.next-terminal.com/
- Chinese documentation: https://docs.next-terminal.com/zh/
- System requirements: https://docs.next-terminal.com/install/system-requirements
- Container installation: https://docs.next-terminal.com/install/container-install
- Quick start: https://docs.next-terminal.com/usage/readme
- Chinese container installation: https://docs.next-terminal.com/zh/install/container-install
- Chinese quick start: https://docs.next-terminal.com/zh/usage/readme
- Troubleshooting: https://docs.next-terminal.com/faq/readme

Documentation covers installation, configuration, reverse proxy, high availability, assets, credentials, SSH/RDP access, Web assets, gateways, Passkey, TOTP, OIDC, mTLS, database audit, upgrades, backup, and troubleshooting.

Product website: https://www.next-terminal.com/
Source repository: https://github.com/next-terminal/next-terminal
